_about: Field terms for F33, same shape as papers/glossary.json.

community-science.definition: records made by volunteers, here photographs of trees with a location and answers to a short form, gathered on a public platform
community-science.excludes: a designed sample: volunteers choose which trees to record, so shares in the data are not rates in the forest

odds-ratio.definition: the odds of decline on wet sites divided by the odds on dry sites, where odds are the probability of decline over the probability of no decline; 1 means no difference
odds-ratio.excludes: a ratio of probabilities, and a causal effect

logistic-regression.definition: a model in which the log odds of the outcome are a weighted sum of predictors, here a wet-site indicator and site covariates
logistic-regression.excludes: any account of which trees came to be recorded

cluster-bootstrap.definition: an interval made by refitting the model many times, here 1,000, on whole sites or plots drawn with replacement, so trees from one place stay together
cluster-bootstrap.excludes: resampling single trees as if they were independent

mantel-haenszel.definition: one odds ratio pooled across strata, here sites, from the two-by-two table of wet or dry against declining or healthy inside each site
mantel-haenszel.excludes: sites that hold only wet or only dry trees, which add nothing to it, and differences between sites

fill-rate.definition: the share of observations in which the observer answered an optional question, compared between declining and healthy trees
fill-rate.excludes: what the answers were; it measures only who answered
